categories.main_business_segments: Ji Yao Holding Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the pharmaceutical and chemical industries. Its pharmaceutical segment includes production and sales of traditional Chinese and Western medicines, biological drugs, health foods, and pharmaceutical packaging materials. The chemical segment focuses on high-dispersion precipitated silica products used in silicone rubber, food additives, and green tires. The company also engages in pharmaceutical commercial distribution, medical care, pharmaceutical R&D, and industrial investment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as precipitation method for producing high-dispersion silica, surface treatment, iron removal, pH control during reactions, and energy-saving processes. It has developed proprietary technologies for high-end silica products and holds ISO9001 certification. Pharmaceutical production covers 15 dosage forms including tablets, capsules, injections, and eye drops, with ongoing R&D for new drugs and secondary development of existing products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical distributors, healthcare providers, and industrial clients in sectors like silicone rubber and coatings. Major customers are large pharmaceutical groups and chemical companies. The company serves markets across China, with significant sales in North China, East China, South China, Northeast, Southwest, Northwest, and Central China regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Jilin Province, China, with operations and sales covering multiple regions nationwide including Northeast China, North China, East China, South China, Southwest, Northwest, and Central China. It also has subsidiaries in Beijing, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Liaoning, and Guangdong provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ji Yao Holding operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical and chemical supply chains. It manufactures pharmaceutical products and chemical additives, distributes medicines through its commercial subsidiaries, and provides medical and healthcare services. It also engages in R&D and industrial investment, positioning itself as an integrated pharmaceutical and chemical group.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in biopharmaceuticals, secondary development of existing drugs, and expanding OTC market products. It emphasizes modernization and internationalization of traditional Chinese medicine, leveraging regional medicinal resources like Changbai Mountain. R&D projects include improving drug quality, extending product life cycles, and developing specialty silica products for new applications. Talent development and strengthening group management are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of pharmaceutical and chemical products. The pharmaceutical segment uses a distribution model selling to commercial pharmaceutical companies, while the chemical segment sells directly to industrial clients. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies, but does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ji Yao Holding is positioned as a significant regional player in pharmaceutical manufacturing and chemical additives in China, with a focus on traditional Chinese medicine and specialty silica products. It faces competition from other pharmaceutical manufacturers and chemical producers in China. The company holds several exclusive or unique drug varieties and maintains a leading market share in high-dispersion silica products domestically.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 333 million, a slight decline from the previous year. It has experienced continuous losses for six years, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 439 million in 2024. Total assets stood at RMB 1.44 billion with liabilities exceeding assets, indicating severe financial distress and liquidity risks. The company faces significant operational and financial challenges, including overdue debts and frozen assets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ji Yao Holding emphasizes product quality as its lifeline and core technology as its driving force. It differentiates through proprietary pharmaceutical formulations, exclusive drug varieties, and advanced chemical product technologies. The company integrates social responsibility with business development, aiming to build a recognized national brand focused on health and life care. Its unique value lies in combining traditional Chinese medicine with modern pharmaceutical innovation and high-end chemical additives.
